description: Source code for Samsung's MFC encoder API implementation, including functions for opening, initializing, executing, closing, and configuring the encoder, as well as buffer management.

methods.name: SsbSipMfcEncOpen
methods.description: Opens the MFC encoder device, maps memory, and initializes context.

methods.name: SsbSipMfcEncInit
methods.description: Initializes encoder parameters based on codec type and configuration.

methods.name: SsbSipMfcEncExe
methods.description: Executes encoding on the current frame.

methods.name: SsbSipMfcEncClose
methods.description: Closes the encoder, frees buffers, unmaps memory, and releases resources.

methods.name: SsbSipMfcEncGetInBuf
methods.description: Allocates and provides input buffer addresses for encoding.

methods.name: SsbSipMfcEncGetOutBuf
methods.description: Retrieves output buffer information after encoding.

methods.name: SsbSipMfcEncSetOutBuf
methods.description: Sets output buffer addresses for encoding output.

methods.name: SsbSipMfcEncSetConfig
methods.description: Configures encoder parameters such as frame type, frame rate, bit rate.
